shared_context.topic: Taking NyQuil and Benadryl at the same time

atoms.1: It is not recommended to take NyQuil and Benadryl at the same time.
atoms.2: Both NyQuil and Benadryl contain antihistamines.
atoms.5: Taking NyQuil and Benadryl together can increase the risk of side effects.
atoms.6: Taking NyQuil and Benadryl together can increase the risk of severe drowsiness.
atoms.7: Taking NyQuil and Benadryl together can increase the risk of dizziness.
atoms.8: Taking NyQuil and Benadryl together can increase the risk of confusion.
atoms.9: Taking NyQuil and Benadryl together can increase the risk of impaired coordination.
atoms.10: Combining NyQuil and Benadryl can potentially lead to an overdose of antihistamines.
atoms.11: An overdose of antihistamines can be dangerous.

snippets.output: It is not recommended to take NyQuil and Benadryl at the same time because both NyQuil and Benadryl contain antihistamines.
Taking NyQuil and Benadryl together can increase the risk of side effects, including severe drowsiness, dizziness, confusion, and impaired coordination.
Combining NyQuil and Benadryl can potentially lead to an antihistamine overdose, and an antihistamine overdose can be dangerous.
